title: Wayfare Pass Plan Change Paths and Limits
content:
# Plan change paths and limits — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

Each Wayfare Pass plan lists the plans it may move up to mid-period and the plans it may move down to at the next renewal.

| Current plan | May move up to mid-period | May move down to at the next renewal |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | none |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | Wayfare Pass Annual, Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | Wayfare Pass Student |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | Wayfare Pass Monthly |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Annual |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Annual, Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | none | Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Annual, Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual |

## Terms common to every plan

| Term | Value on every plan |
|---|---|
| Upgrade proration basis | remaining-days credit: an upgrade starts a new period on the change date and is charged the new plan's fee less the unused value of the current period, the unused value being the current fee times unused days over days in the period |
| When a downgrade takes effect | at the next renewal |
| Most plan changes per billing period | 1 |

## Points of reading

- Wayfare Pass All Access Annual lists no plan to move up to, and Wayfare Pass Student lists no plan to move down to.
- Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly appears as a move-up for Wayfare Pass Student and Wayfare Pass Monthly only.
- Wayfare Pass All Access Annual appears as a move-up for Wayfare Pass Monthly, Annual, Plus Monthly and Plus Annual.
- A membership may change plan at most 1 time per billing period.
